reuse.why: It reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend and extracts the weekend-adjust step from getUpcomingDates into getOccurrenceDay shared by both handlers, though similar wrappers already exist (resolveSkippedWeekend in schedule-template.ts, the loop in getNextDate) and were not consolidated.

duplication.why: The adjust-then-format step is shared rather than copied; the RSchedule construction and try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper are repeated from getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts; the generic weekend-adjust helper would arguably belong in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, the small refactor of getUpcomingDates it needs and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and small with a named padding constant tied to the weekend shift, but the untyped config parameter and a fourth local skipWeekend wrapper in the codebase add mild maintenance cost.
